features: ✅ Universal Multi-Device Support : Connects effortlessly to Windows 8.0+, macOS 10.10+, Android 4.3+ devices — compatible with laptops, desktops, tablets, smartphones, and notebooks.

🔄 Dual Channel Switch Functionality : Toggle between two paired devices instantly with a dedicated switch — perfect for multitasking across work and personal devices.
